db:select.doc:name: Select all collections
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, name, parent_id FROM syskm.collections

db:select.doc:name: Select all requests
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, collection_id, name, pre_request_json, post_response_json FROM syskm.requests

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var cols = vars.raCols default [] var reqs = vars.raReqs default [] fun subtreeIds(id: String): Array<String> = [id] ++ flatten((cols filter ((c) -> c.parent_id == id)) map ((c) -> subtreeIds(c.id))) fun callRequestIdsIn(stepsJson) = ((read(stepsJson default "[]", "application/json")) filter ((s) -> s.'type' == "callRequest")) map ((s) -> s.requestId) var calledIds = flatten(reqs map ((r) -> callRequestIdsIn(r.pre_request_json) ++ callRequestIdsIn(r.post_response_json))) var scopeIds = subtreeIds(vars.raCollectionId) --- reqs filter ((r) -> (scopeIds contains r.collection_id) and !(calledIds contains r.id)) map ((r) -> {id: r.id, name: r.name})

try.doc:name: Run one (never throw — reported as a failed entry instead)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json // run-request's own payload IS the result already — a real DataWeave object, not JSON text // needing read() the way the old loopback http:request's response body sometimes did. var runResult = payload fun checksOf(r) = if (r.iterating == true) flatten((r.iterations default []) map ((it) -> (it.checks default []))) else (r.checks default []) var checks = checksOf(runResult) var checksFailed = sizeOf(checks filter ((c) -> c.passed == false)) var ok = runResult.status == "success" and checksFailed == 0 --- { requestId: vars.raCurrentItem.id, requestName: vars.raCurrentItem.name, status: if (ok) "success" else "failed", durationMs: runResult.durationMs default 0, error: runResult.error, checksPassed: sizeOf(checks filter ((c) -> c.passed == true)), checksFailed: checksFailed, checksTotal: sizeOf(checks), fullResult: runResult }

db:select.doc:name: Collection name
db:select.db:sql: SELECT name FROM syskm.collections WHERE id = :id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var passed = sizeOf(vars.raResults filter ((r) -> r.status == "success")) var failed = sizeOf(vars.raResults) - passed --- { collectionId: vars.raCollectionId, collectionName: (vars.raColRow[0]).name default vars.raCollectionId, runAt: now(), totalRequests: sizeOf(vars.raResults), passedRequests: passed, failedRequests: failed, durationMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - vars.raStartMs, results: vars.raResults }

db:insert.doc:name: Save report
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO syskm.run_all_reports (collection_id, report_json, run_at) VALUES (:id, :report, SYSTIMESTAMP)
